title: ProviderDraft
description: What Devin returns to the Add provider wizard. The wizard shows providerYaml; a person reviews it, names the credential and saves it.

status.description: working while drafting, ready when validation passes, needs_input when only the user can unblock it.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what the provider connects and which actions it offers.

providerYaml.description: The whole Provider file (apiVersion iaf.platform/v1, kind Provider). Empty string until the first valid draft.

assumptions.description: Guesses Devin made where the description was silent: environments, auth type, effects, retry and approval defaults.

questions.description: Only when status is needs_input: at most 3 short questions the reviewer answers in the wizard, such as which credential to use.
